scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix client-app --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix admin-app --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix client-app" "npm run dev --prefix admin-app"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix client-app && npm run preview --prefix client-app" "npm run build --prefix admin-app && npm run preview --prefix admin-app"
